[Discussion] Would Mario games suffer in quality if you'd remove score, coins and lives system from them?

Score definitely not, for most play styles. I think most players generally ignore the score entirely.

Lives probably not - limiting lives was really a necessity from the arcade cabinet days. A game that granted unlimited playtime off a single quarter would a) get hogged all night; and b) not make very much money. A 'Game Over; Insert Coin to Continue' screen would either bleed another quarter out of you, or get you out of the way of the next hopeful youth with a jangling pocket of change. This is why the 'limited lives' concept is all but absent in a post-arcade world. Even in the newest Mario games, you don't really have a Game Over screen anymore, just a 'here's a few more lives; you've been minimally penalized in some way in return'.

Coins I think are necessary because they encourage players to find ways to get them. Tempting players with coins tucked in places they might otherwise avoid I think is an important mechanic.

Score: Nope, 3D Land/World See Below did just that. Anything that got you points before (stomping enemies, flagpole, time remaining, etc.) gave you coins instead.

Coins: Unless replaced with something else, they're definitely needed as small collectibles. They're useful to show players where secrets are and how to do basic maneuvers (a trail of coins showing how to wall jump for example), as well as minor rewards for finding secrets. Finally, people just like to collect stuff so games should play into that design-wise where they can.

Lives: This is the tricky one; I feel that lives are generally an outdated concept, but they're a core part of the formula for Mario. Without them, there would be nearly no reason to collect coins and no real penalty for repeatedly dying (with lives, you'll eventually have to start the whole level over instead of from a midpoint). Without having something else to spend your coins on (maybe a power-up shop on the map screen and power-up vending machines in levels or secret levels to be unlocked with them) there'd be no reason for them if you take out lives. I'd welcome the change, but there would need to be something to balance it out.
